ud1.9:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā gayāyaṃ viharati gayāsīse.
ud1.9:1.3: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā jaṭilā sītāsu hemantikāsu rattīsu antaraṭṭhake himapātasamaye gayāyaṃ ummujjantipi nimmujjantipi ummujjanimmujjampi karonti osiñcantipi aggiṃpi juhanti
ud1.9:2.1: addasā kho bhagavā te sambahule jaṭile sītāsu hemantikāsu rattīsu antaraṭṭhake himapātasamaye gayāyaṃ ummujjantepi nimmujjantepi ummujjanimmujjampi karonte osiñcantepi aggiṃpi juhante
ud1.9:3.1: atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi
